image_description: A hammerhead shark swimming in dark blue water, viewed from a low angle looking up at its ventral side. The distinctive T-shaped cephalofoil is clearly visible, along with the mouth, gills, pectoral fins, and part of the caudal fin. Another shark's tail is partially visible on the left edge.
